name: Audit: PHPStan [DEV ONLY]
description: Runs PHPStan static analysis on custom code. EXPERIMENTAL: Requires phpstan binary installed on the server. Not recommended for production environments as it can be resource-intensive and may expose sensitive code paths.
project_description: audit_phpstan registers the `phpstan` AuditAnalyzer plugin (PhpstanAnalyzer). It auto-detects the `phpstan` binary and recommended extensions (e.g. mglaman/phpstan-drupal), writes a generated `.neon` config, and runs PHPStan via Symfony `Process` (array-form) over the `audit.settings` scan directories at the configured `level`. Results are bucketed into type errors, deprecation warnings and undefined references, each scored; it also reports the PHPStan environment and any project-level `phpstan.neon`/baseline. Configurable memory limit, ignore patterns, Drupal entity-mapping toggles and an error-type allow-list (`active_types`). Marked experimental / [DEV ONLY].
